Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

Yep — you can sometimes cancel after placing an order, but only if it hasn’t been processed/shipped yet. The best move is to reach out as soon as possible, since once an order is fulfilled or tracking is added, it’s no longer eligible for cancellation. If you want, send me your order number or checkout email and I can check your specific order for you 🙂

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
s if it already shipped, can it still be changed?

Usually no—once an order has shipped or is already in transit, we can’t directly change it anymore. That means things like canceling it, adding/removing items, or editing the shipping address typically aren’t possible at that point.

If the issue is the shipping address, our team may still be able to help with next steps once they check the order. If you want, send your order number or checkout email and I’ll help from there 🙂

turns.q: How do I update my contact or account details?
turns.replyTail:
Yep — you can update most of your account details by logging into your account on mudwtr.com and heading to your account settings/profile area. There you can usually change things like your name, email, password, and saved addresses.

Just a heads up: if you’re trying to update the shipping address on an order that was already placed, that’s a separate thing from your account details. In that case, send me your order number or checkout email and I can help check it for you 🙂
